title: Pineapple, Cheese & Cherry Sticks
description: Pineapple, Cheese & Cherry Sticks are a classic Continental canapé featuring juicy pineapple, mild cheese, and bright maraschino cherries. Quick to prepare and visually appealing, they make an ideal appetizer for buffets, cocktail parties, and festive occasions.

ingredients.title: For the Canapés
items: Cheese (mild cheddar or Emmental), cut into 1.5 cm cubes – 200 g
Fresh herbs (finely chopped parsley or mint) – 1 tbsp (optional garnish)
Freshly ground black pepper – a pinch
Toothpicks or canapé skewers – as required

ingredients.title: Optional Continental Garnishes
items: Microgreens or edible flowers – for plating

instruction.title: Step 1 – Prepare the Ingredients
steps: Pat dry the pineapple chunks to avoid excess moisture.
Cut the cheese into even cubes for uniform presentation.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Assemble the Sticks
steps: On each skewer, place one pineapple chunk followed by one cheese cube.
Arrange on a serving platter in neat rows or a circular pattern.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Finishing Touches
steps: Lightly sprinkle freshly ground black pepper over the assembled sticks.
Garnish the platter with chopped parsley or mint.
Drizzle with balsamic glaze if desired.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Serving
steps: Serve chilled as part of a continental canapé platter.
Best consumed within 1–2 hours for maximum freshness.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve chilled as a canapé or party appetizer.
Arrange alongside assorted cheese, olives, crackers, and fresh fruit.
Garnish with microgreens or edible flowers for an elegant presentation.

chefTips: Pat the pineapple dry to prevent the cheese from becoming slippery.
Use smoked cheese for a deeper flavor.
For a gourmet twist, briefly torch the cheese surface before skewering.
Assemble shortly before serving to maintain freshness and appearance.
